Put them in ascending order.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Put these fractions in ascending order of size, show workings.

$\dfrac{3}{5}$ of $30$  

$\dfrac{7}{10}$ of $20$ 

$\dfrac{2}{3}$ of $24$  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Put these fractions in ascending order of size, show workings.
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{3}{5}$ of $30$  
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{7}{10}$ of $20$ 
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{2}{3}$ of $24$  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {First} &= \dfrac{3}{5} \ \text{of} \ 30 \\\\
              &= \dfrac{3}{5} \times 30 \\\\
              &= \dfrac{3 \times 6 \times 5}{5} \\\\
              &= \dfrac{3 \times 6 \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
              &= 18 \\\\
\text {Second}  &= \dfrac{7}{10} \ \text{of} \ 20 \\\\
                &= \dfrac{7}{10} \times 20 \\\\
                &= \dfrac{7 \times 20}{10} \\\\
                &= \dfrac{7 \times 2 \times 10}{10} \\\\
                &= \dfrac{7 \times 2 \times \cancel{10}}{\cancel{10}} \\\\
                &= 14 \\\\
\text {Third}  &= \dfrac{2}{3} \ \text{of} \ 24 \\\\
&= \dfrac{2}{3} \times 24 \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 24}{3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 8 \times 3}{3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 8 \times \cancel{3}}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 16
\end{aligned}
$

Arrange the results in ascending order.

$
\begin{aligned}
& 14 < 16 < 18 \\\\
& \dfrac{7}{10} \ \text{of} \ 20 < \dfrac{2}{3} \ \text{of} \ 24 < \dfrac{3}{5} \ \text{of} \ 30
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{7}{10} \text{ of } 20 \quad \dfrac{2}{3} \text{ of } 24 \quad \dfrac{3}{5} \text{ of } 30$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write the following fractions in order of size, from smallest to largest:

$\dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{5}{6}, \dfrac{7}{12}$

-   $\dfrac{7}{12}, \dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{5}{6}$

-   $\dfrac{7}{12}, \dfrac{5}{6}, \dfrac{2}{3}$

-   $\dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{7}{12}, \dfrac{5}{6}$

-   $\dfrac{5}{6}, \dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{7}{12}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write the following fractions in order of size, from smallest to largest:
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{5}{6}, \dfrac{7}{12}$
<emptyline>
-   $\dfrac{7}{12}, \dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{5}{6}$
<emptyline>
-   $\dfrac{7}{12}, \dfrac{5}{6}, \dfrac{2}{3}$
<emptyline>
-   $\dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{7}{12}, \dfrac{5}{6}$
<emptyline>
-   $\dfrac{5}{6}, \dfrac{2}{3}, \dfrac{7}{12}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Preferred comparison forms (in order)
- Decimals
- Percentages
- Same-denominator fractions
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
& \dfrac {2} {3} \quad \dfrac {5} {6} \quad \dfrac {7} {12} \\\\
& \dfrac {2 \times 4} {3 \times 4} \quad \dfrac {5 \times 2} {6 \times 2} \quad \dfrac {7} {12} \\\\
& \dfrac {8} {12} \quad \dfrac {10} {12} \quad \dfrac {7} {12}
\end{aligned}
$

Put them in ascending order.

$
\begin{aligned}
& \dfrac {7} {12} < \dfrac {8} {12} < \dfrac {10} {12} \\\\
& \dfrac {7} {12} < \dfrac {2} {3} < \dfrac {5} {6}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>A</p>
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{First} &= \dfrac{1}{4} \text{ of } 21 \\\\
             &= \dfrac{1}{4} \times 21 \\\\
             &= \dfrac{21}{4} \\\\
             &= 5.25 \\\\
\text{Second} &= 50\% \text{ of } 11 \\\\
              &= \dfrac{50}{100} \times 11 \\\\
              &= \dfrac{50 \times 11}{100} \\\\
              &= \dfrac{50 \times 11}{50 \times 2} \\\\

                &= \dfrac{11}{2} \\\\
              &= 5.5 \\\\
\text{Third} &= \dfrac{1}{3} \text{ of } 17 \\\\
             &= \dfrac{1}{3} \times 17 \\\\
             &= \dfrac{17}{3} \\\\
             &\approx 5.67
\end{aligned}
$

Biggest $= \dfrac{1}{3}$ of $17$

& 42 \ \text{cm} \quad 0.4 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \quad \dfrac{147}{10} \ \text{cm} \quad 0.351 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \quad 33 \ \text{cm} \\\\
& 42 \ \text{cm} \quad 40 \ \text{cm} \quad 14.7 \ \text{cm} \quad 35.1 \ \text{cm} \quad 33 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Longest $= 42 \ \text{cm}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which is smallest? Circle your answer

- $\dfrac{(2+3)}{(4+6)}$

- $\dfrac{(2\div3)}{(4\div6)}$

- $\dfrac{23}{46}$

- $\dfrac{(2-3)}{(4-6)}$

- $\dfrac{(2\times3)}{(4\times6)}$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which is smallest? Circle your answer
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{(2+3)}{(4+6)}$
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{(2\div3)}{(4\div6)}$
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{23}{46}$
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{(2-3)}{(4-6)}$
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{(2\times3)}{(4\times6)}$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{A}  &= \dfrac{(2+3)}{(4+6)} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{5}{10} \\\\
          &= 0.5 \\\\
\text{B}  &= \dfrac{(2\div3)}{(4\div6)} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{2}{3} \div \dfrac{4}{6} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{2}{3} \times \dfrac{6}{4} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{2 \times 6}{3 \times 4} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{2 \times 3 \times 2}{3 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{3} \times \cancel{2}}{\cancel{3} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
          &= 1 \\\\
\text{C}  &= \dfrac{23}{46} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{23}{23 \times 2} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{\cancel{23}}{\cancel{23} \times 2} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
          &= 0.5 \\\\
\text{D}  &= \dfrac{(2-3)}{(4-6)} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{-1}{-2} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
          &= 0.5 \\\\
\text{E}  &= \dfrac{(2\times3)}{(4\times6)} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{2 \times 3}{4 \times 2 \times 3} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{3}}{4 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
          &= \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
          &= 0.25
\end{aligned}
$

Smallest $= 0.25 = \dfrac{(2\times3)}{(4\times6)}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>E</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{(2\times3)}{(4\times6)}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Cameron has four cards, each with a fraction written on it.

$\boxed{\dfrac {7} {12}} \quad \boxed{\dfrac {1} {2}} \quad \boxed{\dfrac {6} {8}} \quad \boxed{\dfrac {2} {3}}$
  
Arrange the cards in descending order (largest first).

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Cameron has four cards, each with a fraction written on it.
<emptyline>
$\boxed{\dfrac {7} {12}} \quad \boxed{\dfrac {1} {2}} \quad \boxed{\dfrac {6} {8}} \quad \boxed{\dfrac {2} {3}}$
<emptyline>
Arrange the cards in descending order (largest first).
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Preferred comparison forms (in order)
- Decimals
- Percentages
- Same-denominator fractions
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Make the denominators the same.

$
\begin{aligned}
& \dfrac{7}{12} \quad \dfrac{1}{2} \quad \dfrac{6}{8} \quad \dfrac{2}{3} \\\\
& \dfrac {7 \times 2} {12 \times 2}, \quad \dfrac {1 \times 12} {2 \times 12}, \quad \dfrac {6 \times 3} {8 \times 3}, \quad \dfrac {2 \times 8} {3 \times 8} \\\\
& \dfrac {14} {24}, \quad \dfrac {12} {24}, \quad \dfrac {18} {24}, \quad \dfrac {16} {24}
\end{aligned}
$

Arrange in descending order.

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {18} {24} > \dfrac {16} {24} > \dfrac {14} {24} > \dfrac {12} {24} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6} {8} > \dfrac {2} {3} > \dfrac {7} {12} > \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {6} {8} \quad \dfrac {2} {3} \quad \dfrac {7} {12} \quad \dfrac {1} {2}$

</div>
</div>

</div>

</code></pre>

<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Make the denominators the same.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
& \dfrac{7}{12} \quad \dfrac{1}{2} \quad \dfrac{6}{8} \quad \dfrac{2}{3} \\\\
& \dfrac {7 \times 2} {12 \times 2}, \quad \dfrac {1 \times 12} {2 \times 12}, \quad \dfrac {6 \times 3} {8 \times 3}, \quad \dfrac {2 \times 8} {3 \times 8} \\\\
& \dfrac {14} {24}, \quad \dfrac {12} {24}, \quad \dfrac {18} {24}, \quad \dfrac {16} {24}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Arrange in descending order.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {18} {24} > \dfrac {16} {24} > \dfrac {14} {24} > \dfrac {12} {24} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6} {8} > \dfrac {2} {3} > \dfrac {7} {12} > \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write these fractions in order of size from smallest to the largest.

$
\dfrac{5}{8}
\quad \dfrac{2}{3}
\quad \dfrac{1}{2}
\quad \dfrac{7}{12}
\quad \dfrac{17}{24}
$

</div>

\quad \dfrac{17}{24}
$
</code></pre>

& \dfrac {5 \times 3} {8 \times 3} \quad \dfrac {2 \times 8} {3 \times 8} \quad \dfrac {1 \times 12} {2 \times 12} \quad \dfrac {7 \times 2} {12 \times 2} \quad \dfrac {17} {24} \\\\
& \dfrac {15} {24} \quad \dfrac {16} {24} \quad \dfrac {12} {24} \quad \dfrac {14} {24} \quad \dfrac {17} {24}
\end{aligned}
$

Put them in ascending order.

$
\begin{aligned}
& \dfrac {12} {24} < \dfrac {14} {24} < \dfrac {15} {24} < \dfrac {16} {24} < \dfrac {17} {24} \\\\
& \dfrac {1} {2} < \dfrac {7} {12} < \dfrac {5} {8} < \dfrac {2} {3} < \dfrac {17} {24}
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If these numbers are arranged in numerical order, which one will be in the middle?  

$0.77, \quad \dfrac{3}{4}, \quad 0.705, \quad \dfrac{4}{5}, \quad 0.748$

</div>

Put them in ascending order.

& 0.705 < 0.748 < \dfrac{3}{4} < 0.77 < \dfrac{4}{5}
\end{aligned}
$

Middle number $= \dfrac{3}{4}$

**Question**

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In which of the following are the terms NOT getting bigger?

- $\dfrac{1}{5}, \quad 0.25,\quad \dfrac{3}{5}, \quad0.5$   

- $\dfrac{3}{5},  \quad0.7,  \quad \dfrac{4}{5}, \quad1.5$   

- $\dfrac{2}{5},  \quad0.5,  \quad  \dfrac{7}{10}, \quad0.9$

- $\dfrac{3}{5}, \quad0.5, \quad \dfrac{7}{10},\quad0.9$   

- $\dfrac{2}{5}, \quad1.5, \quad \dfrac{10}{5}, \quad2.3$

</div>

B           &= \dfrac{3}{5} \quad 0.7 \quad \dfrac{4}{5} \quad 1.5 \\\\
            &= 0.6 \quad 0.7 \quad 0.8 \quad 1.5 \\\\
            &= 0.6 < 0.7 < 0.8 < 1.5 \\\\
C           &= \dfrac{2}{5} \quad 0.5 \quad \dfrac{7}{10} \quad 0.9 \\\\

D           &= \dfrac{3}{5} \quad 0.5 \quad \dfrac{7}{10} \quad 0.9 \\\\
            &= 0.6 \quad 0.5 \quad 0.7 \quad 0.9 \\\\
            &= 0.6 > 0.5 < 0.7 < 0.9 \\\\
E           &= \dfrac{2}{5} \quad 1.5 \quad \dfrac{10}{5} \quad 2.3 \\\\
            &= 0.4 \quad 1.5 \quad 2 \quad 2.3 \\\\
            &= 0.4 < 1.5 < 2 < 2.3
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= D$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write $0.2$ as a fraction in its lowest terms.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write $0.2$ as a fraction in its lowest terms.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 0.2 \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {2}} {\cancel {2} \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {5}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {5}$

</div>
